title: Propagation threshold approximation
statement: Let $q>0$, and consider an encoded finite unique-games optimization problem with $q$ labels, together with a propagation optimization encoding and a polynomial-time machine that outputs the encoding of the propagation assignment on every canonical game instance. For every valid encoded input, the machine's output is feasible; moreover, if the optimum is at least $1$, the output has value at least $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A propagation optimization encoding is supplied
A propagation search machine with the specified output semantics is supplied
Input belongs to the encoded problem's instance language
